single_workspace_notification.change: Retire internal document-changed; documents-changed owns document, tabs, selection, timeline and paint bucket refresh. Remove shared-window duplicate delivery and RawValue preparation.
single_workspace_notification.scope: Cargo dev + metrics, 24 short CUA drags per variant, one warmup excluded, same updated WebView UI; not physical display latency or controlled Release comparison. Before capture overlapped a mostly sleeping test compiler; after capture preceded new test compilation.
single_workspace_notification.conclusion: Duplicate delivery removed. Differences of under 1 ms do not establish input latency improvement. Snapshot and full-object serialization still dominate notification time.
